summary: Alongkorn Language School is a Thai language school in central Ao Nang, Krabi offering group, private and online Thai courses with ED visa support.

facts.label: Licence
facts.value: Permit from the Ministry of Education for a Thai course for foreigners
facts.quote: Alongkorn Language School has a permit from the Ministry of Education to conduct a Thai Language Course for Foreigners

facts.label: ED visa
facts.quote: we also provide comprehensive ED Visa consultancy

facts.label: Course length
facts.value: 10 to 200 hours, group, one-on-one, online or classroom
facts.quote: Learn Thai 10 - 200 hours choose to study in a group, one-on-one, online or in a classroom and an ED visa is available.

facts.label: Levels
facts.quote: from Beginner, intermediate to Advanced levels

facts.label: Location
facts.value: Main road in central Ao Nang, 500 meters from the beach
facts.quote: located on the main road in Central Ao Nang only 500 meters from the beach front in Ao Nang Krabi
